title: An elevator that actually goes sideways
summary: Tom Scott visits ThyssenKrupp's test tower in Rottweil to see the Multi, a rope-free elevator that uses linear motors to move cabins sideways as well as vertically.
why: HN links it whenever ThyssenKrupp's Multi or paternoster lifts come up, as the clearest look at the working test tower.

quote.text: Here's a tour of the system in their test tower by Tom Scott
